item.title: Swift at Apple: Migrating the TrueType hinting interpreter
item.description:
📝 Font parsers process data from untrusted sources, making the TrueType hinting interpreter a security-critical attack surface. To accompany this post, we’ve also published the source code of the Swift TrueType hinting interpreter. TrueType fonts may contain programs the hinting engine runs through a bytecode interpreter.
🔗 Read more: https://www.swift.org/blog/migrating-truetype-hinting-to-swift/
